name: dotnet-solution-atlas
description: Shows the classes, interfaces and their relationships of a C# or Visual Basic solution as an interactive map.

commands.title: Analyze the solution of the open map again
Compare the open map with a Git commit, branch or tag

dotnetAtlas.dotnetPath.description: Path or name of the dotnet executable used to run the analyzer.

dotnetAtlas.zoomSpeed.description: Speed of zooming with the mouse wheel in the map. 1 is the default, higher is faster. Takes effect the next time a map is opened.

enumDescriptions: Draw a frame around the types of each namespace.
Like grouped, but a namespace frame is placed inside the frame of its parent namespace (Shop.Api inside Shop).
dotnetAtlas.namespaceGrouping.description: How the map shows namespaces when it is opened. Can be changed in the toolbar of the map.

dotnetAtlas.rulesFile.description: Name of the file with the architecture rules (layers and what they may use). It is looked for next to the analyzed solution, then in the workspace folders.

dotnetAtlas.analyzeXaml.description: Read the XAML files (.xaml, .axaml) of the projects. Types that are only used in XAML (windows, user controls, converters, view models) then get a "XAML references" relationship and do not look unused. Switch off to speed up the analysis or if XAML is not relevant. Takes effect with the next analysis.

dotnetAtlas.ignoreUnused.description: Types that are never listed under "Unused candidates", for all solutions. Same keys and patterns as "ignoreUnused" in the rules file (* matches any characters); the lists are added to the defaults and to the rules file.

baseTypes.description: Types derived from these base classes or interfaces, e.g. "MyCompany.Plugins.IPlugin".

attributes.description: Types or members marked with these attributes, e.g. "MyCompany.Serialization.*".

dotnetAtlas.ignoreUnusedDefaults.description: Apply the built-in exceptions for "Unused candidates": types derived from WPF, Avalonia, MAUI, ASP.NET Core or hosting classes, types with test or MEF attributes, types with a Main method.

dotnetAtlas.analyzerPath.description: Path to Atlas.Analyzer.dll. Leave empty to use the analyzer bundled with the extension.
